poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE WEIGHT OF EVERY PASSING SECOND
poetryFrame.rightVertical: A MOMENT SUSPENDED IN GOLDEN LIGHT
poetryFrame.bottomLine: ALWAYS REMEMBER THIS SOFT, FLEETING HUE.
sonnetLines: To hold the hours like fragile glass,
Before the current pulls them past.
We build our peace in fading gleam,
A waking echo of a dream.
The worry whispers on the breeze,
Of futures lost among the trees.
Oh, let the clock hand pause its sweep,
This warmth is precious, thin, and frail,
We gather moments like fine sand,
Held gently in an open hand.
Lest time should steal what we adore,
And leave us wanting something more.
